summary:
I have found the bug ("needle") in the batch processor code and fixed it. 

The issue was in `processor.py` where the array slicing for batches had an off-by-one error (`end = start + batch_size - 1` instead of `end = start + batch_size`). Python slices are exclusive of the end index, which caused the last record of every batch to be dropped.

The fix has been applied and all tests in `test.sh` are now passing successfully.
